facts.value: Arizona State University’s Master of Science in biomimicry online explores the connection between biological principles and design. Upon graduation, you’ll understand how to draw inspiration from nature’s evolutionary successes and apply this knowledge to solve complex human challenges. These versatile skills open doors to impactful roles in business, government and nonprofit organizations.
